Custom Values

Custom values are like personalized settings that you can adjust to make your experience with our snapshot uniquely yours. They give you the power to tailor how the snapshot behaves, ensuring it fits your needs perfectly. Whether it's tweaking configurations or fine-tuning outputs, custom values empower you to make the snapshot work just the way you want it to.

If you go to Settings, then Custom Values, you will see the values we have for you. For each value, you can simply click the three dots on the side of each section to add your own value to the custom values.

Whatever you add to these values will update the entire snapshot with that information, whether it pertains to your website, funnels, automations, emails, and more.

Your Home Improvement Custom Values:

Birthday Campaign Offer: The custom value for the Birthday Campaign Offer can be used to personalize and deliver special promotions or discounts to customers on their birthdays. This value allows you to automatically send a unique birthday offer, making customers feel appreciated and encouraging repeat business.

DR Campaign Offer: The DR Campaign Offer custom value stands for Direct Response Campaign Offer. This value is used to tailor specific, action-driven promotions aimed at generating immediate responses from your audience. It can include special discounts, limited-time offers, or other incentives designed to prompt quick engagement and conversions.

Free Estimate Calendar Link: The Free Estimate Calendar Link custom value is utilized to provide customers with a direct link to schedule a free estimate. This value simplifies the process for potential clients to book a consultation or assessment, enhancing user experience and increasing the likelihood of securing new business.

Google Review Campaign Link: The Google Review Campaign Link custom value is designed to direct satisfied customers to leave a review on your Google Business profile. This value is essential for building and maintaining a positive online reputation, which can attract more customers and boost your business credibility.

Holiday Email Offer: The Holiday Email Offer custom value is used to create special promotions or discounts tailored for holiday seasons. This value allows you to send personalized holiday greetings and exclusive offers, leveraging seasonal shopping trends to increase sales and customer engagement.

Kitchen Upgrade Calendar Link: The Kitchen Upgrade Calendar Link custom value provides a direct link for customers interested in scheduling a consultation or appointment for a kitchen renovation or upgrade. This value helps streamline the booking process, making it easy for potential clients to connect with your services.

Referral Campaign Offer: The Referral Campaign Offer custom value is designed to incentivize existing customers to refer new clients to your business. This value typically includes special rewards or discounts for both the referrer and the new customer, fostering word-of-mouth marketing and expanding your customer base.

Service Area: The Service Area custom value specifies the geographical regions where your business operates. This value is crucial for ensuring that marketing campaigns, offers, and communications are relevant to the target audience within your serviceable locations, optimizing the effectiveness of your outreach efforts.

2. Pipelines

Understanding Sales Pipelines

A sales pipeline is a visual representation of the stages a prospect goes through during the sales process, from initial contact to closing the deal. It helps businesses track and manage their sales activities, allowing them to identify bottlenecks, prioritize leads, and optimize their sales efforts effectively.

Snapshot Pipelines

In our snapshot, you'll find six distinct pipelines tailored to streamline your sales processes:

DR Campaign Pipeline: This pipeline is designed specifically for managing leads generated from your DR (Direct Response) campaigns. It helps you track and nurture these leads through the various stages of the sales cycle until they convert into customers.

Review Campaign Pipeline:The review campaign pipeline allows you to see all of your review requests that were sent through your review campaign, allowing you to see how many left a review versus those who didn't.

3. $1000 Off Kitchen Upgrade Offer Pipeline

Purpose: This pipeline is specifically designed to manage and track leads generated from the $1000 Off Kitchen Upgrade offer. It ensures that each potential customer interested in this promotion is properly nurtured and guided through the sales process.

Description: Leads interested in upgrading their kitchen with a $1000 discount are captured and moved through this pipeline. The sales team contacts these leads, schedules appointments for consultations, and follows up with detailed proposals to close the deal.

4. $1500 Discount Bathroom Remodeling Offer Pipeline

Purpose: This pipeline is designed to manage and track leads interested in the $1500 Discount Bathroom Remodeling offer. It helps streamline the process of converting these leads into customers.

Description: Leads expressing interest in bathroom remodeling with a $1500 discount are entered into this pipeline. The sales team engages with these leads, schedules consultations, and provides detailed proposals to secure the project.

5. FREE Estimates Pipeline

Purpose: This pipeline is dedicated to handling leads who are interested in receiving free estimates for various home improvement projects. It ensures efficient tracking and nurturing of these leads.

Description: Leads seeking free estimates for home improvement projects are tracked in this pipeline. The sales team reaches out to discuss project details, schedules estimate appointments, and provides proposals based on the assessments.

6. Main Home Improvement Pipeline

Purpose: This pipeline manages all other leads that do not fall under specific promotional offers but are interested in general home improvement services. It ensures comprehensive tracking and nurturing of diverse leads.

Description: Leads coming in for various home improvement services, without specific promotional discounts, are managed through this pipeline. The sales team contacts these leads, schedules necessary consultations, and follows up with proposals to convert them into customers.

With these six automated pipelines at your disposal, you can efficiently manage your sales activities, nurture leads, and drive revenue growth for your business.

Appointment Confirmation, Reminders, no-show, & Cancellation Automation

Understanding Appointment Automation

Automated appointment management systems streamline the process of scheduling, confirming, and managing appointments for businesses. By leveraging automation, businesses can enhance efficiency, improve customer communication, and reduce no-show rates, ultimately maximizing productivity and customer satisfaction.

Snapshot Appointment Automation

In the Home Improvement snapshot, we offer comprehensive automation for appointment confirmation, reminders, no-shows, and cancellations. Here's how it works:

Appointment Confirmation: When someone books an appointment on either calendar, they will receive an automated confirmation email or text message, ensuring that their appointment is successfully scheduled and confirmed.

Appointment Reminders: Prior to the scheduled appointment, automated reminders will be sent to the customer to minimize the risk of no-shows and ensure that they are prepared and ready for their appointment.

No-show Management: In the event of a no-show, the system will automatically tag the customer accordingly, allowing you to follow up and reschedule as needed to minimize disruptions to your schedule and workflow.

Cancellation Handling: If a customer cancels their appointment, the system will update their status accordingly. For example, on the free estimate Calendar, if they book an appointment, they will be updated as "appointment booked" in the pipeline. If they cancel, their status will be updated to "canceled," and if they fail to show up for the appointment, they will be marked as "no show" in the pipeline.

5. Link Trees

Understanding Link Trees

Link trees are an innovative tool designed to optimize the user experience by consolidating multiple links into a single, easily accessible webpage. They serve as a centralized hub for directing traffic to various destinations such as websites, social media profiles, contact forms, and more. Link trees are particularly beneficial for businesses as they simplify navigation, increase engagement, and improve conversion rates.

Snapshot home improvement Link Trees

In our snapshot, you'll discover four specialized home improvement link trees, each offering unique functionalities tailored to enhance your online presence and streamline customer interactions:

Benefits of Link Trees

Enhanced Accessibility: By centralizing important links in one location, link trees make it easier for customers to find the information they need, ultimately improving user experience and satisfaction.

Increased Engagement: Customizable link trees allow you to tailor your messaging and visuals to resonate with your target audience, increasing engagement and driving conversions.

Streamlined Communication: With dedicated link trees for specific purposes such as scheduling appointments or contacting support, you can streamline communication channels and effectively manage customer inquiries and requests.

With these four home improvement link trees at your disposal, you can leverage the power of centralized navigation, personalized messaging, and engaging visual content to enhance your online presence and drive business growth.

6. Funnels

Understanding the Home Improvement Funnels

$1000 Off Kitchen Upgrade Funnel

Purpose: The $1000 Off Kitchen Upgrade Funnel is designed to attract and convert leads interested in kitchen renovation services by offering a $1000 discount on the project.

Description: This funnel begins with an engaging landing page highlighting the $1000 discount offer for kitchen upgrades. Potential customers are prompted to provide their contact information to claim the discount and schedule a consultation. Once the lead submits their information, they are redirected to a thank-you page and receive an automated email confirming their interest and providing further details. The lead's information is then passed into the Kitchen Upgrade Pipeline and the Kitchen Upgrade Calendar for follow-up and appointment scheduling.

$1500 Discount Bathroom Remodeling Funnel

Purpose: The $1500 Discount Bathroom Remodeling Funnel aims to attract and convert leads interested in bathroom remodeling services by offering a $1500 discount on the project.

Description: This funnel features a compelling landing page that showcases the $1500 discount offer for bathroom remodeling. Visitors are encouraged to enter their contact details to take advantage of the discount. After submitting their information, leads are directed to a thank-you page and receive an automated confirmation email with more information about the offer. The lead's details are then integrated into the Bathroom Upgrade Pipeline and the Bathroom Upgrade Calendar for follow-up and appointment scheduling.

FREE Bath Remodel Quote Funnel

Purpose: The FREE Bath Remodel Quote Funnel is designed to generate leads by offering a free quote for bathroom remodeling projects.

Description: This funnel includes a landing page that promotes a free quote for bathroom remodeling. Interested visitors are asked to fill out a form with their contact information to receive the free quote. Upon submission, leads are taken to a thank-you page and sent an automated email confirming their request and providing next steps. The lead's information is then funneled into the Estimate Pipeline and the Estimate Calendar for follow-up and quote scheduling.

Home Improvement Lead Magnet Guide Funnel

Purpose: The Home Improvement Lead Magnet Guide Funnel aims to attract and capture leads by offering a valuable guide on home improvement as a free resource.

Description: This funnel starts with a landing page offering a free guide on home improvement tips and best practices. Visitors are encouraged to provide their contact details to download the guide. After submitting their information, leads are directed to a thank-you page where they can download the guide immediately and receive an automated email with a download link. The lead's details are then added to the Main Home Improvement Pipeline for further nurturing and follow-up, allowing the sales team to engage with potential customers who have shown interest in home improvement.

Funnel Automations:

Each funnel will be fully automated, with the name of each automation matching the corresponding funnel. Similarly, the funnel forms will be named identically for easy organization. When someone opts into a funnel, they will be seamlessly updated in the sales pipeline, tagged appropriately, and trigger an internal notification for you. Additionally, the lead will receive a personalized text and email with their offer upon opting in. If they proceed to book an appointment through the funnel, the appointment reminder automations will be triggered.

It's important to note that each automation and text message can be easily customized to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a cohesive and personalized experience for your leads.

7. 52 Week Nurture Campaigns

In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive 52-week email and text home improvement nurture campaigns designed to cultivate relationships with your leads and keep the business top-of-mind. Here's what you can expect:

52-Week Email Nurture Campaign: This campaign consists of a series of weekly emails delivered to your home improvement leads over the course of a year. Each email contains valuable tips, industry insights, and exclusive offers tailored to their needs and interests. The goal of this campaign is to keep the business front and center in the minds of your leads while providing them with ongoing value and engagement.

52-Week Text Nurture Campaign: Similarly, the 52-week text nurture campaign delivers weekly text messages to your leads, keeping them informed and engaged with the business. These texts may include quick tips, special promotions, or reminders about upcoming events or services. The goal is to maintain regular communication with your leads through a convenient and accessible channel, fostering a sense of connection and trust.

Benefits of Nurture Campaigns

Long-Term Relationship Building: By delivering consistent value and engagement over an extended period, nurture campaigns help to build strong relationships with your leads, positioning your business as a trusted and reliable partner.

Increased Engagement: Regular communication through emails and text messages keeps your business top-of-mind and encourages ongoing interaction with your leads, increasing engagement and retention rates.

Customizable Content: You have the flexibility to customize the content of both the emails and text messages to align with your branding, messaging, and marketing objectives. Whether it's sharing educational content, promoting special offers, or inviting leads to events, you can tailor the campaigns to suit your unique business needs.

With our 52-week email and text nurture campaigns, you can stay connected with your leads, provide them with valuable insights and offers, and nurture them towards conversion over the long term.

8. Database Reactivation

Understanding Database Reactivation Campaigns

Database reactivation campaigns are strategic marketing initiatives aimed at re-engaging with inactive or lapsed leads in your database. These campaigns help revitalize your contact list, rekindle interest in your products or services, and ultimately drive conversions. In our snapshot, we offer two types of database reactivation campaigns: a basic version and an advanced version, each offering unique features and functionalities.

Snapshot Database Reactivation Campaigns

Basic Database Reactivation Campaign: The basic campaign provides a straightforward approach to reactivating dormant leads in your database. You have the flexibility to customize the offer for this campaign using a custom value. This campaign aims to reconnect with inactive leads, remind them of your value proposition, and encourage them to re-engage with your business.

Advanced Database Reactivation Campaign (DR Campaign): The advanced campaign takes database reactivation to the next level by incorporating dynamic lead management features. Similar to the basic campaign, you can customize the offer using a custom value. However, this campaign goes a step further by updating leads in a dedicated DR campaign pipeline. If a lead responds positively to the campaign, they will be moved to a "responded" status in the pipeline, indicating active interest. Conversely, if they indicate disinterest, they will be moved to a "not interested" status, allowing you to focus your efforts on more promising leads.

10. Referral Campaign Workflow

Referral campaigns are powerful marketing strategies designed to leverage the existing customer base to acquire new customers. By incentivizing customers to refer friends, family, or colleagues to your business, referral campaigns can rapidly expand your customer network and drive growth. In our snapshot, we offer a comprehensive referral campaign feature that enables you to easily create and manage referral programs tailored to your business needs.

Snapshot Referral Campaign

Customizable Referral Incentives: Our referral campaign feature allows you to customize the incentives offered to customers for referring new business. By utilizing custom values, you can tailor the incentives to align with your promotional strategies and budget. Whether it's offering discounts, freebies, or exclusive rewards, the referral campaign feature empowers you to create compelling incentives that motivate customers to spread the word about your business.

Benefits of Referral Campaigns

Expanded Customer Base: Referral campaigns tap into the power of word-of-mouth marketing to attract new customers. By leveraging the networks of your existing customers, you can rapidly expand your customer base and drive growth for your business.

Enhanced Trust and Credibility: Recommendations from friends or family members are highly trusted by consumers. By encouraging referrals, you can capitalize on this trust and credibility to attract high-quality leads and convert them into loyal customers.

Cost-Effective Marketing: Referral campaigns are a cost-effective way to acquire new customers compared to traditional advertising channels. Since referrals come from satisfied customers, the cost per acquisition is typically lower, resulting in a higher return on investment.

With our customizable referral campaign feature, you can harness the power of word-of-mouth marketing to drive growth and success for your business.

11. Incoming Lead Follow Up Workflows

Incoming lead follow-up workflows are automated processes designed to promptly respond to inquiries and messages from potential customers across various communication channels. These workflows ensure that every lead receives a timely and personalized response, increasing the chances of conversion and providing exceptional customer service. In our snapshot, we offer four incoming lead follow-up workflows tailored to different communication channels: Google My Business (GMB) message, email, Facebook message, and Instagram direct message (DM).

Snapshot Incoming Lead Follow-Up Workflows

GMB Message Workflow: This workflow is triggered when someone sends a message through your Google My Business listing. The workflow automatically tags the lead, updates their status in the pipeline as responded to, and notifies the business owner. You can easily customize the messaging and actions of this workflow to suit your preferences and brand voice.

Facebook Message Workflow: When a potential customer sends a message to your Facebook page, the Facebook message workflow springs into action. It tags the lead, updates their status, and alerts the business owner, enabling seamless communication and follow-up through Facebook Messenger.

Instagram DM Workflow: The Instagram DM workflow handles incoming direct messages on your Instagram account. It automatically tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the business owner, facilitating quick and effective engagement with potential customers on Instagram.

With our incoming lead follow-up workflows, you can effectively manage inquiries and messages across multiple communication channels, providing timely and personalized responses to potential customers.

13. Invoice Reminders, Cancellation, & Refunds

Automation for invoice management streamlines the process of handling invoices, reminders, cancellations, and refunds, ensuring smooth and efficient financial transactions for your business. These automated workflows help you stay organized, reduce administrative burden, and provide a seamless experience for your customers.

Snapshot Automation for Invoice Management

Invoice Reminders Automation: This automation sends timely reminders to customers who have outstanding invoices, prompting them to make payment. By automating invoice reminders, you can minimize late payments, improve cash flow, and maintain positive relationships with your customers.

Cancellation Automation: When a customer cancels a service or appointment, this automation ensures that the cancellation process is handled smoothly and efficiently. It updates the customer's status, triggers any necessary refunds, and notifies relevant stakeholders, allowing you to manage cancellations with ease and professionalism.

Refunds Automation: In cases where refunds are warranted, this automation handles the refund process seamlessly. It initiates the refund, updates the customer's status accordingly, and provides notifications to both the customer and your team, ensuring transparency and accountability in the refund process.

Key Features and Customization Options

Timely Notifications: Each automation sends timely notifications to customers and stakeholders, keeping them informed throughout the invoicing, cancellation, and refund processes.

Customizable Messaging: You have the flexibility to customize the messaging of each automation to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a consistent and professional experience for your customers.

14. Missed Call Text Back

The Missed Call Text Back Automation is a proactive response system designed to engage with potential leads who have attempted to contact your business but were unable to connect via phone. This automation sends a text message to the missed caller, providing them with an opportunity to book a consultation or appointment with your business. By leveraging this automation, you can effectively follow up with missed leads and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Snapshot Missed Call Text Back Automation

Engagement Text Message: When a call goes unanswered or is missed, the automation triggers a text message to be sent to the caller's phone number. The message is crafted to be engaging and inviting, encouraging the caller to consider booking a consultation or appointment with your business.

Call to Action: The text message includes a clear call to action, such as a link to your online booking system or a phone number to call back, making it easy for the recipient to take immediate action and schedule a consultation.

Personalization: To enhance engagement and relevance, the text message can be personalized with the caller's name or other relevant details, creating a more personalized and tailored experience for the recipient.
